items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Sometimes he had a set of drums, but most of the time he'd be using them. I had a job on my end getting the drums from him.

ctx.x: and then you can take your wire brushes on your drum and don't drown them man I'd play soft you know take two sticks of wire brushes when that phrase come on this beat nice and soft and don't drown them out. When did wire brushes come in? Yeah they come in but they've been here wire brushes some drummers used to adopt them with one stick and one wire. I still do that to the day. Alfred does that too. Yeah one stick you can tell all the old jazz drummers but a real these fellas in the latest late 30s they'll take…
Yeah. Yeah. Uh Cy Frazier uh 16 to the second 61. Uh anybody in your family start playing drums Cy you know. Yeah my oldest brother Sam Frazier. Sam Frazier. Yeah. Well who did he play with anybody?
I was playing with Rene Punch by the Petit. It was way around 1917, 16, 18. All beginning of World War I.
